_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Site Survey Report (SSR)
summary: The Site Survey Report documents the contractor's site survey findings and identifies discrepancies between contract-described conditions and actual on-site conditions.
use_relationship:
The SSR documents the findings of the contractor's site survey. The SSR is used to identify any discrepancies between conditions described by the contract and actual on-site conditions.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
b. The SSR is applicable to any acquisition of telecommunications equipment.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The SSR shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The SSR shall contain the following:

children.title: Title page.
children.content: The title page shall contain the following information:

children.title: Contract data requirements list (CDRL) data item number.
Table of Contents.
children.content: The Table of Contents shall identify all paragraphs and the corresponding page number.

children.title: Introduction.
children.content: The Introduction shall contain the following information:

children.title: Results.
children.content: The Results section shall be the main body of the report. It shall contain a complete listing of the contractor's findings. This section shall include a summary of all anticipated minor construction required, findings on cable routes, and distances, and findings on availability of existing manholes and ducts. This shall also include a list of circuits and demarcation points which have not been finalized or which require additional coordination with end users. This section shall fully document and explain any other findings concerning on-site conditions in this section.

children.title: Conclusions and recommendations.
children.content: This section shall summarize the results of the survey and present conclusions. The conclusion shall also identify any discrepancies between the contract and survey results. This section shall contain any recommendations that contractor has based on the survey. Any actions required from the Government by the contractor shall be noted here.
